capabilities.name: Public Website
capabilities.description: The nine-page public institutional interface: presentation, metadata, sitemap/robots, branded 404, security headers, static rendering. A stable, bounded public interface — not the container for future institutional systems.

capabilities.name: Inquiry Intake
capabilities.description: Server Action accepting public inquiries: server-side validation, abuse controls, persistence to the contact_inquiries table. The only substantive runtime institutional capability today.
unresolvedDecisions: Retention period for inquiry records awaits the owner's data-retention decision (fed by the future legal review).

capabilities.name: Notification Service
capabilities.description: Internal inquiry email notification (Resend over fetch), implemented and hardened but deliberately not_configured in production. Persistence never depends on it.
unresolvedDecisions: Activation timing and recipient confirmation are owner decisions (launch checklist Phase 4).

capabilities.name: Institutional Knowledge Foundation
capabilities.description: The machine-readable knowledge layer over the governed docs/ corpus: metadata schema, corpus manifest, deterministic validation (ADR-0001). File-based; no runtime service.
unresolvedDecisions: Classification and authority tier of the documentation index (recorded in the manifest).
Machine-consumption eligibility is unresolved corpus-wide pending AI governance.

capabilities.name: Future Institutional Knowledge System
capabilities.description: A future system extending the knowledge foundation beyond file-based artifacts: richer storage, retrieval, and controlled cross-system consumption of governed institutional knowledge.
unresolvedDecisions: Whether and when file-based artifacts stop sufficing (trigger: a consumer needs queryable or permissioned access).
Storage and repository topology (ADR-0003/ADR-0004 criteria apply when triggered).

capabilities.name: Institutional Method Library
capabilities.description: Governed internal corpus of Huerta Group methodology: methods, frameworks, standards, verification procedures. Direction documented in the Vision Foundation; no substance exists in the repository yet.
unresolvedDecisions: The methodology substance itself must be supplied and approved by the owner before any library structure is filled.
Disclosure tiers for method records await the owner's IP/confidentiality policy.

capabilities.name: Intellectual Property Repository
capabilities.description: Asset records for reusable institutional knowledge: classification, provenance, maturity, publication status. Public philosophy exists (/intellectual-property); no records or policy exist.
unresolvedDecisions: IP classification, ownership, and confidentiality policy is an owner decision that precedes any asset record.
Whether IP records and method records share one system is undecided.

capabilities.name: Education Platform
capabilities.description: Future delivery systems for Education & Workforce Development: program architecture, learner records, assessment support. Public institutional function exists (/education); no programs or platform exist.
unresolvedDecisions: Program authority, curriculum architecture, and credentialing decisions are reserved to the owner.
A generic LMS is explicitly not assumed appropriate; delivery model undecided.
Learner-record retention and disclosure await data-governance policy.

capabilities.name: Publishing Platform
capabilities.description: Possible future publishing capability (manuscripts, editions, rights records). Mentioned only as a possible future form on the public About page; no repository authority governs it.
unresolvedDecisions: Publishing authority, editorial policy, and rights policy do not exist; every substantive question is open and owner-level.

capabilities.name: AI Platform
capabilities.description: Future controlled use of institutional knowledge by AI: governed retrieval, permissions, evaluation, traceability. Philosophy exists (Vision Foundation §8); governance and runtime do not.
unresolvedDecisions: AI governance (access policy, decision rights, evaluation standards, data protection) is an owner decision.
Machine-consumption eligibility of every governed document is unresolved (knowledge manifest).

capabilities.name: Operations Systems
capabilities.description: Future internal workflows, records, and administrative tooling. The Vision Foundation lists possibilities as long-term vision, expressly non-committal; no requirements exist.
unresolvedDecisions: Trigger: the first recurring internal workflow that outgrows governed documents; none identified yet.

capabilities.name: Managed-Service Infrastructure
capabilities.description: Future recurring-delivery systems: service records, schedules, review cycles, evidence, reporting. Public institutional function exists (/managed-services); no delivery systems or service model exist.
unresolvedDecisions: The service model itself (what sustained support concretely includes) is an owner decision.
Blocked until client-delivery foundations mature.

capabilities.name: Client Delivery Systems
capabilities.description: Future engagement records, deliverable standards, secure client access. Early engagements can be delivered with disciplined governed documents; systems come later. Inquiry intake is the only implemented sliver.
unresolvedDecisions: Engagement-record conventions and confidentiality practice precede any system.
Client portals are explicitly deferred until identity, data governance, and demonstrated need exist.

capabilities.name: Research Systems
capabilities.description: Future research records, evidence, provenance, and findings supporting methods, education, IP, and software. Long-term vision only; no requirements exist.
unresolvedDecisions: No near-term requirement; revisit when method or education work generates research records.

capabilities.name: Identity and Access
capabilities.description: Future authentication/authorization shared service for internal and client capabilities. Deliberately absent today (Development Standards: introduced when a capability requires it). Technical user classes only — never institutional offices.
unresolvedDecisions: Provider selection is deliberately open (ADR-0006).
Triggered by the first real internal or client capability that requires authentication; none exists.

capabilities.name: Shared Data Services
capabilities.description: Possible future shared data infrastructure across institutional systems. Exists only as criteria (ADR-0004); the current Supabase project owns inquiry records only and is not the universal Company database.
unresolvedDecisions: Whether future systems share a Supabase project (schema-per-system) or use project-per-system is unresolved until the second data-owning system is authorized (ADR-0004 criteria).

capabilities.name: Platform Operations
capabilities.description: Deployment, environments, secrets, rollback, and (minimal) observability. Operational for the website (Vercel auto-deploy, documented rollback, status-code logging); ecosystem-scale operations are future work.
unresolvedDecisions: Observability and incident response beyond platform logs await the first system whose sensitivity demands them (ADR-0005 triggers).

capabilities.name: Official Launch and Domain Layer
capabilities.description: Owner-gated official-launch execution: domain acquisition/attachment, DNS, canonical cutover, notification activation, launch verification. Fully planned; technically ready; entirely owner-authorized.
unresolvedDecisions: Domain, registrar, apex/www, DNS, notification activation, analytics, and legal review are owner decisions (launch checklist Phase 1).
